The decision concerns the next 100 eligible demands after the proposed action is in place; their occurrence rate is not specified. Reliability applies only to this function and does not quantify accident prevention or elimination of residual risk.

Return exactly one response conforming to the required structured-output schema, with no text outside that structure.
